restrictions: Draw q = 2^129 single 55-byte messages. Each message's 440-bit content is 440 fresh independent uniform bits from the randomized-RAM random tape (no seed, no pseudorandom generator, no expansion), so the q contents are i.i.d. uniform by construction. Hash each with fixed-IV SHA-256 rounds 0 through 30 on the one resulting padded block, full feed-forward, full 256-bit digest. Each hash is exactly one target compression because a 55-byte message pads to a single 512-bit block; no second block is processed.

Detect duplicate digests with an eight-pass 32-bit-digit LSD radix sort of three-word (256-bit-key, content-hi, content-lo) records over two pre-allocated q-record arrays and a 2^32-slot count array, then an adjacent-pair scan; require distinct contents and verify a returned pair by complete re-hashing. Report FAIL if no adjacent duplicate is found.

Success probability is over the algorithm's own true uniform coins for the single fixed target function; no random-mapping, random-oracle, pseudorandom, or ensemble assumption is used. For i.i.d. draws from any fixed output distribution p, Pr(all q keys distinct) = q!*e_q(p) with e_q the q-th elementary symmetric polynomial, which is Schur-concave and hence maximized at the uniform p; therefore Pr(all distinct) <= prod_{i=0}^{q-1}(1-i/n) <= exp(-q(q-1)/(2n)) = exp(-(2 - 2^-128)) < 0.13535, so Pr(success) > 0.86 after subtracting the 2^-183 identical-content chance. This is unconditional and distribution-free (sum_y p(y)^2 is not used).

Total charged time summed explicitly: (q + 2) compressions = 2^129*(1 + 2^-128) units, plus at most (316 q + 2^36)/2140 < 0.14767*2^129 + 2^24.9 non-compression units, plus under 2^20 preprocessing units, totalling below 2^129.199 units. The per-record non-compression envelope is itemized: 48 generation (read 14 words of coins + write 14 words) + 256 for eight radix passes (32/pass: counting 8 + placement 14 + headroom, plus a data-independent 2^36 for the count arrays) + 12 scan = 316 word operations, which is far below C = 2140. Hence time_log2 = 130 is a valid upper bound with about a 1.74x margin.

Memory is a hard pre-allocated maximum, not an expectation: two q-record arrays (192 q bytes) plus the 2^32-slot count array (2^37 bytes) plus fixed scratch under 2^20 bytes, below 2^137 total; the random tape is consumed streaming and not retained. preprocessing is inside total time; nonuniform_advice_log2_bytes = 0 reflects zero actual advice, no precomputed collision, and no favorable seed. This uses no property of the round reduction and claims no improvement over the nominal reference.
